summary: The Department of the Interior acknowledged EPA's forthcoming noise standards for recreational vehicles under the Noise Control Act of 1972 and stated it is working cooperatively with EPA and other agencies to develop Federal noise standards for ORV, while noting that current research is not advanced enough for a final decision and that existing regulations prohibit excessively noisy ORVs from Interior lands.
text:
3. Establishment of noise levels in decibels
With regard to the establishment of noise standards and criteria for ORV, the Environmental Protection Agency will be promulgating standards and regulations for recreational vehicles under Section 6 of the Noise Control Act of 1972. These standards will apply to the manufacture of such vehicles, but will be based, among other things, on the "conditions of use" of the vehicle. We believe that these standards for various recreational vehicles will be of assistance to land managers in applying noise-level criteria for ORV use on Interior lands.
The Department of the Interior is working in cooperation with the Environmental Protection Agency and other Federal agencies to develop Federal noise standards for ORV. We are also working in conjunction with industry, user groups, and private individuals on this matter. Many improvements have been made in the vehicles being manufactured today, and noise levels are generally much lower than those in the earlier machines. In addition, many States have enacted legislation which mandates by specified dates the manufacture of machines with specified minimum noise levels. Further, the research efforts underway by industry, universities, and the various governmental agencies concerning ORV noise and its effects are not advanced enough at this time to provide adequate data for a final decision concerning Federal noise standards for these vehicles. The Department will continue its efforts to minimize the effects of excessive ORV noise in terms of the present state of the arts on this subject, and has made provisions in its ORV regulations which prohibit ORV that produce excessive noise from Interior lands.
